hints.title: BST Target Guided Search
hints.text: Descend the tree to find the smallest node strictly greater than the target node.

hints.title: Candidate Tracking on Left Branching
hints.text: When moving left, the current node is a valid successor candidate because its value exceeds the target.

hints.title: Iterative Successor Search
hints.text: Initialize successor = null. While root is not null: if root.val > p.val, record root as successor candidate and move left to find smaller candidates. Else move right.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: H: height of binary search tree
complexity.notes: Optimal logarithmic successor descent running in constant auxiliary memory.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full inorder traversal takes O(N) time and O(N) memory.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Taking advantage of binary search tree order descends directly in O(H) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Avoid full tree traversal by updating successor whenever branching left.
